payload.answer: Three project states plus one error case. (1) Brand new project: no jobs ever queued, no engine_health rows, no worktree directory -- exercises empty queue_depth, empty circuits, and the managed_root.exists() false arm at line 114. (2) Active project with jobs and recorded circuits but no worktree directory on disk -- separates 'no worktrees' from 'new project', which the first case conflates. (3) Project with a populated worktree root, covering the iterdir/sorted arm. (4) fetch_dashboard_state against an unknown project id, asserting ValueError -- line 87. Drive rendering through Textual's Pilot harness rather than asserting on widget internals, so the tests survive a layout change.
